summary: Smoke test of restored Klinik Suel Motor project in new environment. Backend: 13/13 pytest passed via public URL (health, 4-role login, auth/me, 21 authenticated GET endpoints with no 500s, RBAC spot checks, create->GET persistence). Frontend: login as owner and kasir via preview URL both work; owner dashboard renders omzet/antrian/kasir/owner stat cards + profit trend; Antrian, Stok, Lainnya tabs navigate and render; kasir sees role-based UI (kasir stats visible, owner stats hidden, Stok tab hidden). Zero browser console errors. No deprecated Expo packages detected in reviewed files.

react_native_issues.issue: Uses expo-router/unstable-native-tabs (unstable API) for iOS 26 branch. Reference: /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/_layout.tsx:3. Web/Android unaffected.

action_items: Optional: migrate away from expo-router/unstable-native-tabs once a stable API is available (low priority, iOS 26 only)
Optional: backend/server.py is a ~3900-line monolith; consider splitting into routers for maintainability (restored code, not a regression)
critical_code_review_comments: backend/server.py is a single ~3900-line file containing all routes, seed logic, and integrations - exceeds the 700-line guideline but is restored legacy code, functioning correctly
Auth is solid: argon2 via pwdlib, idempotent seed with $setOnInsert, constant-time dummy-hash verify for unknown users, JWT from env vars
MongoDB _id correctly excluded from projections (e.g., /users uses {'_id': 0, 'hashed_password': 0})
Frontend uses process.env.EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL for API base (src/api.ts) - no hardcoded URLs
